owner: Roblox High School QA & Contract / Content QA

referenceViewport.note: Normalized geometry is derived from visible captured frames. It is an evaluation target, not a universal hard-coded viewport.

primaryRail.note: four large colored rounded primary actions

utilityRail.note: smaller colorful utility tiles below primary rail

mustMatch: No large permanent central free-roam panel.
Top-right status is dark stacked chrome with bright accent rows, not one pale card.
Four primary right-rail actions remain visually large and color-distinct.
Bottom quick items are discrete glossy rounded slots, not a flat toolbar.
World view remains dominant.

headerBlue.note: bright blue band with angled right edge

tabs.note: gold active tab + deep-blue inactive tab

mustMatch: Dark navy body.
Bright blue title/header band with white Travel title.
Close control clearly reachable at modal top-right.
Gold active tab and blue inactive tab immediately below header.
Destination cards read as image-card tiles with dark label strips.
Persistent status/rail/quick HUD remains visible around the panel.
authorityTolerance: The canonical implementation may expose fewer interactive destination cards than the reference because server-approved destination authority is intentionally narrower.
Non-authorized destinations must not become functional merely for visual density.

mustMatch: Dominant blue shop family may replace the ordinary free-roam rail.
Left preview and right browse/details areas are visually distinct.
Header/tabs/search/sort/card grid form a coherent saturated-blue interface.
Selected/active tabs use gold accent.
Close control is white outlined on dark navy.
Never populate fake products or prices.
Purple patterned header with white title and close/back family.
White content body with dark bold hierarchy.
Gold performance meter.
Purple progression treatment.
Bright green rounded OK action.
Compact edge HUD remains visible around the result surface.

globalVisualRules: Primary UI font family should be Gotham/GothamBold/GothamMedium or closest Roblox built-in rounded modern sans, not Arial-heavy legacy presentation.
Primary panel body language is dark navy with saturated blue, gold and purple accents.
White strokes/highlights and subtle dark shadowing provide glossy RHS2 tile depth.
Rounded controls are medium-radius, not pill-heavy and not square-flat.
Persistent free-roam UI is edge-anchored and compact.
Modal hierarchy is visually obvious: header -> tabs/summary -> content -> close/back/dismiss.
regressionRejects: Primary persistent status root rendered as pale LEGACY_PANEL.
Travel rendered as one pale generic panel with only a large text button.
Primary rail buttons rendered as unstyled text-only rectangles.
Quick slots rendered as unoutlined flat rectangles.
Any large permanent free-roam panel covering the center sightline.
A visual-parity PR changing ClassSessionController, ProgressionRepository, EconomyRepository, VehicleLifecycle, HousingLifecycle, ShoppingPurchaseController or other server authority modules.
Any unverified icon, destination, price, gem/weather value, catalog item or hidden UI hierarchy introduced solely for appearance.

deviceAcceptance.required: Composition close to the reference while retaining the repository's normalized safe geometry.
Same visual hierarchy with scaled/reflowed controls; no left movement or right camera/action touch obstruction.
Same hierarchy at larger native scale; no stretched oversized panels or dead center obstruction.

parityStatusRule: Static contracts may certify structure/style intent only. The final label 'exact RHS2 visual parity' requires actual rendered captures compared against these frames at comparable aspect/FOV and device metadata.
